Provides a resource to create a WAF bot id rule

> **NOTE:** When using the current `tencentcloud.Waf.BotIdRule` resource configuration, if you need to customize configuration field `data`, it is recommended to first import all bot rules into Terraform for management using the `pulumi import` command.

## Example Usage

package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/waf"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		_, err := waf.NewBotIdRule(ctx, "example", &waf.BotIdRuleArgs{
			Domain:       pulumi.String("demo.com"),
			SceneId:      pulumi.String("3000000001"),
			ProtectLevel: pulumi.String("normal"),
			GlobalSwitch: pulumi.Int(5),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}

## Import



WAF bot id rule can be imported using the domain#sceneId, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Waf/botIdRule:BotIdRule example demo.com#3000000001
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
